rows.grounds: locative adverb referring to the place mentioned in the preceding verses
instrumental of means; compound of piṇḍa and pradāna

items.question: What lasting result arises from offering rice-balls at that place?
premises: The action is the offering of rice-balls.
items.inference: Therefore, offering rice-balls there brings about eternal satisfaction.
uncertainties: The specific recipients of the satisfaction are not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: There, by offering rice-balls, eternal satisfaction arises.
